## How to Use

**Filtering.** Each column has a box under its heading. Type to show only rows
containing that text (case-insensitive); the *Rank* and status columns are drop-down
lists. Filters combine, and the search box above the table searches several
columns at once.

**Navigation.** Click a row to select it (one at a time). Then:

- **Select None**: deselect the current row.
- **Jump to parent**: show the parent taxon of the selected row.
- **Jump to accepted**: for a synonym, show its accepted name.
- **Show synonyms**: list all synonyms of the selected accepted name.
- **Show children**: list the direct children of the selected taxon.

A button is greyed out when it does not apply to the selected row.

**Other buttons.**

- **Show / Hide higher taxa**: toggle the Class, Subclass, Order, Suborder,
  Family, Subfamily and Genus columns.
- **Reset**: clear all filters and the selection.
- **Download CSV**: download the rows currently shown (after filtering and
  sorting), with all columns.

If you use these data, please cite the PPG version shown (with its DOI) shown on the Data Browser tab.
